title: 第九章 炼灵法决第十章 罗云门之变
lines: “破开他的位点玄罩!”
“截杀血击!”
此时太原谷的巨型竞选场中，不论是场外还是场内，都有着冲天的叫杀声传出。
整个竞选场从下至上，成巨柱般直通天宇，中心镂空，填充着成千上百个巨型石台，成叠罗之势，散于其内。
每方石台足有百丈大小，顶部被某种成半圆之形的强悍禁制覆盖，阻隔其内各修士争斗间散发出的能量波动。
让得在每一方石台外围观看的修士，都能更加仔细的观看其内修士争斗的激烈程度。
而此时的雷涅正催动着一件中级灵器，悬于千米高空，望着一方石台内的争斗。
此时，石台内的双方修士正战的焦灼。
一名长相颇为邪意的修士，正手持一杆类似于铁棍状的灵器，狂暴舞动间带起漫天玄气，往对面的对手怒砸而去。
而对面的对手，则是一名身穿一袭麻布灰袍，长相清秀的青年，此时的青年望着对手攻过来的滔天声势，却是嘴角划起一抹冷笑，单手一记打出，一股极为精纯的火属性玄气便自其中激射而开，化为一道流光，一闪即逝下，已经掠至了那长相邪意的修士身后。
而修士手中的棍棒真器，只差一点便要点到青年的鼻尖，可也就是这么一丝的距离，却成为其永远也达不到的鸿沟！
修士全身上下散发而出的玄气波动，于此刻彻底消散。
随即整个停顿在空中，俯冲向青年的身形，瞬间瘫倒!
“炎刹胜出！成为覆天宗外门弟子！”
一名掌管此石台的覆天宗弟子，再看到竞选争斗出了结果后，当即宣布了胜出者的名字，以及肯定了其成为覆天宗外门弟子的身份。
周遭观看的修士，在看到场中的战斗竟会以此种方式落幕，一个个接是惊奇不已。
互相讨论着先前战斗的细节之处。
“哎！你看到了吗？刚才那风清修施展的法决威力都足以与凡化境巅峰的修士的普通一击匹敌了！”
“是啊，但结果还是落败了。这名为炎刹的修士究竟是从哪冒出来的，竟然能如此轻易的将风清修给击败!”
“风清修可是那蓝宇谷修行家族中，年轻一辈数一数二的存在，现在被这般击败，也只能说这炎刹极为不简单！”
在众多的议论修士中，雷涅在观得场中的最终争斗结果时，并未感到有所意外。
而相比之下，其更为感兴趣的，是那名为炎刹的青年，在最后所施展的，属于精纯火属性的玄气攻击。
这攻击看似只是将单纯的火属性玄气凝炼压缩，最后汇聚于掌心间瞬时打出，从而一招破敌至胜。
但若不是其中有着一缕雷电玄气，率先的侵蚀掉对手的护体玄气。
要想如此轻易的击败对手，无异于痴人说梦。
雷涅感到最为惊奇的是，一个人的体内竟能在凝炼完本源玄气后，体内还能存在多种有别于本源玄气属性的其它属性玄气。
要知道，不管什么属性的玄气，在被吸纳进体后，都会被体内的本源玄气同化为同一种属性的玄气。
这可是天地间的修炼铁则！
但这名为炎刹的青年却完美的避开了这一铁则，若是将其修炼功法给弄到手的话。
雷涅心下想着。
随即便驾驭着飞行法器，远离了此处，雷涅能来此石台前观战，本身目的便是来观察，那名为炎刹的青年在修炼功法上与常人的异处。
如今战斗已经结束，没有留下去的必要，若是自己现在是本体亲至，自己就会以记收弟子的名义将那炎刹收为弟子，当然最终的目的还是要获取其能掌控多种玄气属性的秘密。
可惜，现在是以叶不休的身份出现，若是在交涉过程中，让其察觉到异处，打草惊蛇下，可能会让其溜掉。
“还是有机会再出手吧。”
雷涅轻叹一声，直往离太原谷最近的交易坊市中奔去。
content_en:
"Kill!"
"Break his mysterious position mask!"
"Interception and bloody blow!"
"Broken!"
At this time, in the giant campaign field in Taiyuan Valley, whether outside or inside the field, there were shouts of killing rising to the sky.
From bottom to top, the entire campaign field stretches straight into the sky like a giant pillar. The center is hollow and filled with hundreds of giant stone platforms scattered in a stack.
Each square stone platform is a hundred feet in size, and the top is covered by some kind of powerful semicircle-shaped restriction, blocking the energy fluctuations emanating from the battles between the monks inside.
This allows the monks watching from the outside of each square stone platform to more carefully observe the intensity of the battle between the monks inside.
At this time, Rene was activating an intermediate spiritual weapon, hanging a thousand meters in the air, looking at the fight on a stone platform.
At this time, the monks on both sides of the stone platform were fighting anxiously.
A rather evil-looking monk was holding a spiritual weapon similar to an iron rod. He danced violently and brought up the sky full of profound energy, and smashed it at the opponent opposite.
The opponent opposite was a handsome-looking young man wearing a linen gray robe. At this time, the young man looked at the overwhelming momentum of his opponent's attack, but a sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth. He struck out with one hand, and an extremely pure fire-attribute profound energy shot out from it and turned into a stream of light. In a flash, it had already rushed behind the evil-looking monk.
The real stick in the monk's hand was just a hair away from reaching the tip of the young man's nose, but this small distance became a gap that he could never reach!
The profound energy fluctuations emanating from the monk's body completely dissipated at this moment.
Then the whole thing stopped in the air, dived towards the young man's figure, and collapsed instantly!
"Yan Cha wins! Become an outer disciple of Futian Sect!"
A disciple of the Futian Sect in charge of this stone platform, after seeing the outcome of the election battle, immediately announced the name of the winner and confirmed his status as an outer disciple of the Futian Sect.
The monks watching around were all surprised when they saw that the battle in the field ended in this way.
Discussing the details of the previous battle with each other.
"Hey! Did you see it? The power of the magic spell performed by Feng Qingxiu just now is enough to rival the ordinary blow of a monk at the peak of the Mortal Realm!"
"Yes, but we still lost in the end. Where did this monk named Yansha come from, and he was able to defeat Feng Qingxiu so easily!"
"Feng Qingxiu is one of the top young people in the Lanyu Valley cultivation family. Now that he is defeated like this, it can only be said that this Yansha is extremely extraordinary!"
Among the many discussing monks, Rene was not surprised when he saw the final result of the battle.
In contrast, what he was more interested in was the mysterious attack of pure fire attribute performed by the young man named Yan Cha at the end.
This attack seems to be just a condensation and compression of pure fire-attribute profound energy, and finally it is gathered in the palm of the hand and fired instantly, thus defeating the enemy in one move and winning the victory.
But if it weren't for a wisp of thunder and lightning profound energy, it would be the first to erode the opponent's body-protecting profound energy.
To think of defeating the opponent so easily is tantamount to wishful thinking.
What surprised Reine most was that after condensing the original profound energy, a person's body could still contain a variety of other attributes of profound energy that were different from the original mysterious energy.
You must know that no matter what attribute the mysterious energy is, after it is absorbed into the body, it will be assimilated into the same attribute by the original mysterious energy in the body.
This is the iron rule of cultivation between heaven and earth!
But the young man named Yansha perfectly avoided this iron rule, if he could get his hands on the cultivation techniques.
Rene thought to herself.
Then he controlled the flying magic weapon and stayed away from this place. The purpose of Rennie coming to this stone platform to watch the battle was to observe the differences between the young man named Yansha and ordinary people in his cultivation techniques.
Now that the battle is over, there is no need to stay. If he were to come in person now, he would accept Yansha as a disciple in the name of a disciple. Of course, the ultimate goal is to obtain the secret of his ability to control various mysterious attributes.
It's a pity that he is now appearing as Ye Bujiu. If he notices something strange during the negotiation process and scares the snake, he may be allowed to escape.
"It's better to take action again if there is a chance."
Rene sighed softly and ran straight to the trading market closest to Taiyuan Valley.
